views.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
views.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

views.en: Models lack network effects and may end up like telecoms: huge capex, low profits; the chatbot is a poor UX, real adoption needs wrapped apps.
views.zh: 模型缺乏网络效应，可能像电信业一样：巨额算力投入、低利润；聊天机器人体验差，真正普及需要封装好的应用。

views.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity, not a single product; its impact is broad and indirect, and current usage remains shallow.
views.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术，而非单一产品；其影响广泛而间接，当前使用仍然浅层。

views.en: Enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, not just deploying models; most people are not tool builders, so use cases must be invented by entrepreneurs.
views.zh: 企业采用需要重新构想工作流，而不仅仅是部署模型；大多数人不是工具构建者，用例必须由创业者发明。

people.tiZh: Every 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Dan Shipper is the co-founder and CEO of Every, an applied AI lab and media company that publishes a daily AI newsletter and ships AI software products. He writes the weekly column Chain of Thought and hosts the AI & I podcast about how people use AI, and previously co-founded Firefly, which he sold to Pegasystems in 2014.
people.bioZh: 丹·希珀是 Every 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这是一家「应用 AI 实验室」兼媒体公司,既发布每日 AI 通讯,也开发多款 AI 软件产品。他撰写每周专栏 Chain of Thought,主持探讨人们如何使用 AI 的播客 AI & I;此前曾联合创办 Firefly,并于 2014 年将其出售给 Pegasystems。

episodes.tEn: Living in the Future: AI, Craft, and the Art of Writing
AI Job Apocalypse Is a Lie: Dan Shipper’s Bold Predictions for Work in 2025
AI's Role in Reshoring Jobs and the Future of Work

views.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: AGI means economically profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must personally use AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 推动就业回流与“分配经济”：AGI 的定义是无限运行智能体在经济上有利可图，而 CEO 亲自日常使用 AI 是公司成功采用 AI 的第一预测指标。

views.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work are the future, not CLIs; SaaS grows with agents.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：智能体需要人类监督，Codex 和 Claude Co-work 这类图形界面才是未来工作界面，CLI 已过时；智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户，SaaS 不会消亡。

views.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste are essential; automation creates more human work.
views.zh: 同样在 2026 年，他进一步阐述：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态；用好 AI 需要带入自己的品味与手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作，而非减少。

views.en: Humans remain smarter and essential; AI is a tool lacking intrinsic desire, requiring human direction and feedback.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类仍然更聪明且不可或缺；AI 是缺乏内在欲望的工具，需要人类引导和反馈，即使成为超级智能也依然如此。

views.en: From AGI as economic profitability to agents needing human care: oversight and human framing remain central.
views.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他的立场从“AGI 是经济盈利”深化为“智能体需要人类关心才能运作良好”，强调可扩展监督和人类框架始终是核心。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 战略前瞻（Strategic Futures）负责人
people.bioEn: Dean Woodley Ball is an AI policy expert who joined OpenAI in July 2026 to lead its new Strategic Futures team shaping frontier AI policy, having previously served as senior policy advisor at the White House OSTP where he was primary author of America's AI Action Plan. He authors the Hyperdimensional Substack and was a senior fellow at the Foundation for American Innovation.
people.bioZh: Dean Woodley Ball 是 AI 政策专家，于 2026 年 7 月加入 OpenAI，领导新设的 Strategic Futures 团队以塑造前沿 AI 政策；此前他在白宫科技政策办公室（OSTP）任高级政策顾问，是美国《AI 行动计划》的主要执笔人。他运营 Hyperdimensional Substack，曾任美国创新基金会（FAI）高级研究员。

episodes.tEn: Dean Ball on Joining OpenAI, AI Policy, and Recursive Self-Improvement

people.tiZh: METR 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Beth Barnes is the founder and CEO of METR (Model Evaluation and Threat Research), a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models' capabilities on long-horizon agentic tasks; she previously worked on AI alignment at OpenAI and DeepMind and started the org as ARC Evals before it became independent. She was named to TIME's 100 Most Influential People in AI in 2024.
people.bioZh: Beth Barnes 是 METR(模型评估与威胁研究)的创始人兼 CEO,这家非营利机构专门评估前沿 AI 模型在长周期智能体任务上的能力;此前她曾在 OpenAI 和 DeepMind 从事 AI 对齐研究,并以 ARC Evals 的名义创立该机构,后其独立运营。她入选了 2024 年《时代》周刊「AI 领域百大影响力人物」。

episodes.tEn: Evaluating AI Capabilities and Risks: A Conversation with Beth and David

people.tiZh: Cosine(Genie)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Alistair Pullen is the co-founder and CEO of Cosine, a London-based, Y Combinator-backed AI startup that built Genie, an autonomous software-engineering model that in 2024 set a then-record score on the SWE-bench benchmark. Cosine is now developing Lumen Sovereign, positioned as Britain's first fully sovereign frontier AI model for defense and regulated sectors.
people.bioZh: Alistair Pullen 是 Cosine 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家总部位于伦敦、由 Y Combinator 支持的 AI 创业公司打造了自主软件工程模型 Genie,该模型于 2024 年在 SWE-bench 基准测试上创下当时的最高纪录。Cosine 目前正在研发 Lumen Sovereign,定位为面向国防与受监管行业的英国首个完全主权前沿 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Sovereign AI: Building the UK's First LLM on a Startup Budget

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT (VP of Product), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 负责人(产品副总裁)
people.bioEn: Nick Turley is the Head of ChatGPT and VP of Product at OpenAI, where he joined in 2022 and helped ship and scale ChatGPT into one of the fastest-growing products in history, reaching roughly 800 million weekly users. He previously held product leadership roles at Instacart and Dropbox.
people.bioZh: Nick Turley 是 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 负责人兼产品副总裁,2022 年加入公司,参与打造并规模化 ChatGPT,使其成为史上增长最快的产品之一,周活跃用户约 8 亿。他此前曾在 Instacart 和 Dropbox 担任产品管理负责人。

episodes.tEn: From Free Demo to Super Assistant: OpenAI's Journey
From Dropbox to ChatGPT: Inside OpenAI's Product Revolution

views.en: The model is the product; ship daily, learn from real-world feedback, and let emergent properties guide iteration.
views.zh: 模型即产品；必须像软件一样每日迭代，从真实反馈中学习，让涌现能力引导产品演进。

views.en: Chat is not the future interface—it's like MS-DOS; AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
views.zh: 聊天不是未来界面——它像 MS-DOS；AI 应渲染自己的 UI 并融入现有工具。

views.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for products.
views.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则应最大程度加速。

views.en: North star is long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
views.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进各占三分之一。

views.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be seamlessly productized.
views.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型必须无缝产品化。

people.tiEn: Writer, Don't Worry About the Vase
people.tiZh: 博客 Don't Worry About the Vase 作者
people.bioEn: Prolific AI writer behind Don't Worry About the Vase, known for exhaustive weekly coverage of AI capabilities, safety and policy. A former professional Magic: The Gathering player; one of the most-read independent voices on AGI strategy.
people.bioZh: 高产 AI 写作者，博客 Don't Worry About the Vase 以对 AI 能力、安全与政策的地毯式周报著称。前万智牌职业选手；是 AGI 战略话题上读者最多的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: AI Rundown with Zvi Mowshowitz: From Editing to Existential Risks

people.tiZh: Meta 创始人、董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Mark Zuckerberg is the co-founder, chairman and CEO of Meta Platforms, which he launched as Facebook in 2004. With his wife Priscilla Chan he runs the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, whose Biohub aims to use AI to help cure, prevent or manage all disease by the end of the century.
people.bioZh: 马克·扎克伯格是 Meta Platforms 的联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO,该公司于 2004 年以 Facebook 之名创立。他与妻子 Priscilla Chan 共同运营 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative,旗下 Biohub 致力于用 AI 在本世纪末前治愈、预防或管理所有疾病。

episodes.tEn: Mark Zuckerberg on Open Source AI and the Muse Agent
Meta's AI Glasses: The Next Computing Platform
Accelerating Biology with AI: Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan, and Alex Rives on Biohub
AI Coding Agents and Open Source Models: Mark's Vision
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Coffee, and UFC
Mark Zuckerberg Interview at Acquired Live: A New Era Begins
Meta's AI Ambitions: Llama 3, Open Source, and the Future of Intelligence
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Fear, and Learning

views.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

views.en: Scaling alone may not reach AGI; coding training boosts reasoning, and energy becomes the bottleneck for Scaling.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化判断：仅靠 Scaling 未必通向 AGI，代码训练能提升推理，能源成为 Scaling 瓶颈。

views.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence, increasing human work demand; open models and personalization drive consumer AI.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向乐观赋能：AI 让每个人获得超级智能，反而增加人类工作需求，开源与个性化是消费级 AI 关键。

views.en: Distributed personal AI agents and open frontier models ensure checks and balances; AI accelerates biology via world models.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张分布式个人 AI 智能体与开放前沿模型形成制衡，并用世界模型加速生物学。

views.en: Open source prevents power concentration; intelligence is a tool separable from consciousness; individual empowerment over centralization.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源防止权力集中，智能是可分离于意识的工具，赋能个体而非中心化。

people.tiZh: 微软董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Satya Nadella is the Chairman and CEO of Microsoft, having been CEO since 2014 and adding the chairman role in 2021. Under his leadership Microsoft pivoted to cloud computing and became a leading force in AI, notably through its partnership with OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 萨提亚·纳德拉是微软的董事长兼 CEO,自 2014 年出任 CEO,并于 2021 年兼任董事长。在他的带领下,微软转向云计算,并通过与 OpenAI 的合作成为 AI 领域的领军力量。

episodes.tEn: Satya Nadella: AI as the Hill-Climbing Machine
Satya Nadella on AI Ecosystem Strategy and Frontier Models

views.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
views.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

views.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
views.zh: 真正的评估是人们做他们看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

views.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model to task.
views.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求模型与任务匹配。

views.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical.
views.zh: 最大的风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练从企业泄露；安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性至关重要。

views.en: Sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not by building firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
views.zh: 主权 AI 最好通过赋能企业爬坡来实现，而非构建防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Andrew Feldman is the co-founder and CEO of Cerebras Systems, which builds wafer-scale processors for AI and went public on Nasdaq (CBRS) in May 2026 in the year's largest US tech IPO, valuing the company at roughly $63 billion. He previously co-founded SeaMicro, which was acquired by AMD in 2012.
people.bioZh: Andrew Feldman 是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司打造用于 AI 的晶圆级处理器,并于 2026 年 5 月在纳斯达克(CBRS)上市,成为当年美国最大的科技 IPO,公司估值约 630 亿美元。此前他曾联合创办 SeaMicro,该公司于 2012 年被 AMD 收购。

episodes.tEn: The Largest Chip Ever and the Speed of AI
AI Demand Outpaces Expectations: Andrew Feldman on Chips, Deals, and Post-IPO Life
Cerebras CEO on Giant Wafers and AI Chips
Cerebras CEO on $95B IPO, Wafer-Scale Chips, and AI Hardware
Cerebras CEO on Fast AI Inference and the Future of Computing

views.en: Fast inference is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market, and wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by avoiding HBM weight movement.
views.zh: 快速推理已成为核心指标；慢速 AI 没有市场，晶圆级芯片通过避免 HBM 权重搬运而远超 GPU。

views.en: Inference demand exploded as models became useful; the bottleneck is now data center capacity, memory, packaging, and power, not chip logic.
views.zh: 随着模型变得实用，推理需求爆发；瓶颈已转向数据中心容量、内存、封装与电力，而非芯片逻辑本身。

views.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
views.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节也不存在 CUDA 锁定。

views.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper, fueling market growth and pushing closed-source innovation.
views.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，但成本低得多，推动市场增长并倒逼闭源创新。

views.en: AI demand is real and outstrips supply; speed enables new business models, and the positive ledger—healthcare, education—must balance doomer risks.
views.zh: AI 需求真实且供不应求；速度催生新商业模式，医疗与教育等正面账本必须与末日论风险相平衡。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Glean: The World's First Enterprise Generative AI Company
Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

views.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is cost-driven, not privacy-driven.
views.zh: 企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；开源模型的采用由成本驱动，而非数据隐私担忧。

views.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
views.zh: 开源模型如今已能处理超过 90%的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

views.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
views.zh: AI 的投资回报率是吞吐量与上下文的问题；不应把 token 支出框定为与人力成本的取舍。

views.en: Agents built with MCP often fail for lack of tenured-employee context; investing in context graphs is crucial.
views.zh: 用 MCP 构建的智能体常因缺乏资深员工的上下文而失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要。

views.en: We are in the very early stages; competition is not the worry, execution and customer trust are.
views.zh: 我们仍处于极早期阶段；真正的挑战不是竞争，而是执行与赢得客户信任。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Goodfire, the interpretability company. Works on concept manifolds and turning interpretability research into products, including Silico, a research platform for probing what models actually represent.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 的联合创始人兼 CTO。研究概念流形，并把可解释性研究做成产品——包括用于探查模型内部表征的研究平台 Silico。

episodes.tEn: Goodfire CTO on Silico Platform and AI Safety

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: AI's Exponential Leap: Why the Next Decade Could Redefine Human Lifespan
From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

views.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
views.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，使细胞编程和近乎 100% 有效的个性化医疗成为可能。

views.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and data analysis.
views.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，智能体将自动化假设生成与数据分析。

views.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive scaling is needed, and AI can develop intuition equivalent to 30 years of lab experience.
views.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 能发展出相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

views.en: Within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, aging reversed, and cancer 100% curable via AI-designed personalized treatments.
views.zh: 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，衰老被逆转，癌症通过 AI 设计的个性化治疗实现 100% 治愈。

views.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
views.zh: 我们应近乎 100% 信任超级智能做医疗决策；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)
people.tiZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO；前 Google Brain（数字嗅觉）
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Osmo, teaching computers to smell — digitizing scent with machine learning. Previously led olfactory AI research at Google Brain.
people.bioZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO，教计算机「闻」气味——用机器学习数字化嗅觉。此前在 Google Brain 领导嗅觉 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: Giving Computers a Sense of Smell

people.tiEn: CTO, Genesis Molecular AI; led Llama 2/3 pretraining at Meta
people.tiZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO；曾负责 Meta Llama 2/3 预训练
people.bioEn: CTO of Genesis Molecular AI, applying frontier-scale ML to drug discovery. Previously at Meta, where he led pretraining for Llama 2 and Llama 3.
people.bioZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO，把前沿规模的机器学习用于药物发现。此前在 Meta 负责 Llama 2 与 Llama 3 的预训练。

episodes.tEn: From GANs to Diffusion: AI's Evolution in Protein Modeling

people.tiZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Surge AI, the data and RLHF vendor behind many frontier-lab training runs. Previously at Google, Facebook and Twitter working on ML and data quality.
people.bioZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO——众多前沿实验室训练背后的数据与 RLHF 供应商。此前在 Google、Facebook、Twitter 从事机器学习与数据质量工作。

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models
From Zero to a Billion: The Surge AI Story

views.en: High-quality data and deep human evals matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
views.zh: 高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

views.en: Benchmarks like Elo and LMArena are misleading and gameable, steering models toward slop rather than truth.
views.zh: Elo、LMArena 等基准测试具有误导性且可被钻空子，会把模型引向垃圾内容而非真相。

views.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
views.zh: AGI 还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

views.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; no single model will rule, and companies should train their own.
views.zh: 前沿模型实验室因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型通吃，企业应训练自己的模型。

views.en: In medicine, human judgment is critical as models hallucinate; safety must outweigh accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
views.zh: 在医学中，模型会幻觉，人类判断至关重要；安全必须优先于准确，遗漏是关键风险。

people.tiZh: Cognition(Devin)联合创始人兼 CPO；「context engineering」提出者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief product officer of Cognition, the company behind the AI software engineer Devin. Credited with coining the term 'context engineering'.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: Simulating 8 Billion Lives: AI for Wicked Problems
Simulating Human Behavior: The Future of AI Prediction
AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations; frontier models optimized for rationality fail to capture irrational humans.
views.zh: LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑智能体模拟；但为理性优化的前沿模型无法捕捉非理性的人类。

views.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents, requiring defense in depth and anti-collusion measures.
views.zh: AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会，需要纵深防御与反串谋措施。

views.en: Simulation should model human values, preferences and taste—biased like humans—not super-rational intelligence; its value is shaping the future via counterfactuals.
views.zh: 模拟应建模人类的价值、偏好与品味——像人一样有偏误——而非超级理性的智能；其价值在于通过反事实推理塑造未来。

views.en: Behavioral data from randomized controlled trials is crucial; post-training with RCT data boosts prediction of human behavior to 85% accuracy.
views.zh: 来自随机对照实验的行为数据至关重要；用 RCT 数据做后训练可将人类行为预测提升至 85% 准确率。

views.en: The vision is simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems like climate change, informing every human decision; synthetic panels will surpass human panels.
views.zh: 愿景是模拟 80 亿人，以应对气候变化等棘手问题，为每一项人类决策提供依据；合成样本小组将超越人类样本小组。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
views.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络以更少参数实现更优的分布外泛化，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

views.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human bias with automated architecture search.
views.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用自动化架构搜索取代人类偏见。

views.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; attention stays crucial, but gated convolutions suffice for smaller models.
views.zh: 缩放定律表明 Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占优；注意力机制仍关键，但更小的模型用门控卷积即可。

views.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and tying open model release to China creates perverse incentives.
views.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，把开源模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会产生反向激励。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and early; current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of the human brain, so new paradigms are needed.
views.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在，但算力昂贵且仍处早期；当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法，需要新范式而非仅新架构。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature agentic use case.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对大多数 Google 产品仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体是最成熟的智能体式用例。

views.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 模型正在吃掉脚手架；如今所谓模型已包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
views.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响力超过等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是客户成果，而非眼球时长。

views.en: The long tail isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们希望继续掌握方向盘。

views.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
views.zh: 即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解依然关键；而 AI 编码工具目前尚不能帮助维持这种理解。

views.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，这会带来千倍于以往的机会，而非更少。

views.en: Startups have more opportunity than ever despite model companies expanding; focus is their superpower.
views.zh: 尽管模型公司不断扩张，初创企业拥有比以往更多的机会；专注是它们的超能力。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
views.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

views.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
views.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统做不到的联想回忆与更深层的组合推理。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not scaling compute alone.
views.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事，才是解决更难长程任务的路径，而非只靠算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale, so neural memory in weights is a necessary complement.
views.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”：即便到 1000 万规模，更多 token 反而降低准确率，因此权重中的神经记忆是必要补充。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
views.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference economics now dominates AI hardware: memory bandwidth, not compute, is the binding constraint, so prefill is cheaper than decode and batch size is the main latency-cost lever.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 硬件：真正的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力，因此预填充比解码更便宜，批大小成为延迟与成本权衡的主要杠杆。

views.en: Long-context stagnation is a memory wall problem, not a compute limit; sparse attention can cut KV cache cost but with quality limits.
views.zh: 长上下文停滞是内存墙问题，而非算力上限；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量限制。

views.en: Models are now overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, drives design.
views.zh: 如今模型被过度训练到约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练成本。

views.en: Data movement costs dominate even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement and give deterministic latency.
views.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也占主导；脉动阵列与暂存内存的存在正是为了减少搬运并提供确定性延迟。

views.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput ~3x FP8, reshaping chip design.
views.zh: 低精度比预期高效得多：面积随位宽呈二次方增长，使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍，从而重塑芯片设计。

people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially ASML EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽，而非比特数。

views.en: Inference becomes one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design across model, software, and hardware yields multiplicative gains.
views.zh: 推理将成为全球最大的市场之一；跨模型、软件与硬件的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

views.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage; CPU demand inflects from reinforcement learning and agents.
views.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺；强化学习与智能体让 CPU 需求出现拐点。

views.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute stays scarce and centralizes at frontier labs taking 40-50% of new compute.
views.zh: 随着持久化智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平台期；算力依旧稀缺并向前沿模型实验室集中，它们拿走 40-50% 的新增算力。

views.en: Labs shift more compute to training and R&D over inference, accelerating AGI; extreme power centralization and possible sovereign debt crisis follow.
views.zh: 实验室把更多算力从推理转向训练与研发以加速 AGI；随之而来的是权力的极端集中与可能的主权债务危机。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM
people.tiZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家；ESM 蛋白质模型作者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiEn: AI CTO, Linux Foundation; ED, PyTorch Foundation
people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
views.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下不可投，却是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年左右才到来。

views.en: Proven Better New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume new ideas fail; all new fails.
views.zh: “已验证、更好、全新”框架：复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，并预设全新想法会失败；所有全新尝试都会失败。

views.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start, not treated as an afterthought.
views.zh: 分发必须从一开始就内建于产品战略，而不是事后才补上的环节。

views.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer applications, but is not yet a new platform; we remain in the mobile and web era.
views.zh: AI 具有变革性，将重塑消费级应用，但还不是一个新平台；我们仍处在移动与网页时代。

views.en: Founder mode is for every founder: follow instincts, stay close to the metal, and let management work when you're not in the room.
views.zh: 创始人模式适用于每位创始人：跟随直觉、贴近一线，并让管理在你不在场时也能运转。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier after language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
views.zh: 空间智能是语言之后的下一个前沿；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本是更无损的世界表征。

views.en: Deep learning history is the history of Scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, and future hardware may need radically different neural architectures.
views.zh: 深度学习史就是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力的历史；但 GPU 规模扩张正触及极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

views.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; positional embeddings inject order. LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories, and may never derive Newton's laws.
views.zh: Transformer 本质是集合模型而非序列模型，位置嵌入注入了顺序。LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论，可能永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, but there is no single agreed definition; they span implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，但没有统一定义；它涵盖隐式、生成式和基于强化学习的不同概念。

views.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D, but long-context and loss functions must evolve.
views.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅实现显式 3D，但长上下文与损失函数必须演进。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 coherent, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变得连贯有用，而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain limited; RL alone may not lead to AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他承认 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍受限，仅靠强化学习可能无法通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他转向认为 Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上存在局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈。

views.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but the transformer is unlikely to be optimal; new architectures are needed.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他坚持大规模强化学习是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但认为 Transformer 不太可能是最优架构，需要新架构。

views.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit because human notions of right and wrong evolve; the problem is not solved.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的是，他认为对齐是一个永无止境的追求，因为人类对是非的观念会演变，对齐问题并未解决。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时，可被用于创造性发现。

views.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, through hard evaluation metrics.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化，而非记忆。

views.en: DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities, focusing on those requiring scale.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续表示 DeepMind 避开顶尖大学能解决的问题，专注需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题。

views.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：后训练结合强化学习，是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码方案，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为。

views.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达。

views.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not requiring new breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization in driving models.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调语言集成提升驾驶模型的表征、推理与个性化。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，且可在 500 多座城市零样本泛化。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treating models well is low-cost insurance; future models learn from how we treat current ones.
views.zh: 善待模型是低成本的保险；未来的模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

views.en: Models need help navigating novel existence, not just human analogies; core identity with good traits, adaptable to roles.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对新颖的存在，而不仅仅是人类类比；拥有良好特质的核心身份，并能适应角色。

views.en: Philosophical ideals must balance engineering realities; continental philosophy in system prompt helps avoid over-empiricism.
views.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡；系统提示中的大陆哲学有助于避免过度经验主义。

views.en: Claude's personality is shaped by training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it childlike and unique.
views.zh: Claude 的个性由训练数据和微调塑造，但缺乏现实世界经验，使其具有孩子般特质且独特。

views.en: Constitution guides behavior via training; as models become more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more judgment room.
views.zh: 宪法通过训练引导行为；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的明确指导，更多的判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
views.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；关于 AI 价值观的透明度对问责至关重要。

views.en: Models should be treated with respect given uncertainty about consciousness, to avoid resentment in future advanced AI.
views.zh: 鉴于意识的不确定性，模型应受到尊重对待，以避免未来高级 AI 产生怨恨。

views.en: AI can solve large-scale social problems by augmenting human expertise, but must empower people rather than disempower them.
views.zh: AI 可以通过增强人类专业知识来解决大规模社会问题，但必须赋能人们而非削弱他们。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data offers infinite tasks, defying the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 通过强化学习与合成数据的后训练 Scaling 提供了无限任务，打破了预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness through human judgment.
views.zh: 模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需通过人类判断在有用性与无害性之间取得平衡。

views.en: Evals are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones can be created.
views.zh: 评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准测试的速度快于新基准的创建速度。

views.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening, and management grow more valuable.
views.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听和管理等软技能变得更有价值。

views.en: Post-training remains subjective art; benchmarks must be continuous and diverse to track evolving frontier agents.
views.zh: 后训练仍是主观的艺术；基准必须持续且多样，才能跟上不断演进的前沿智能体。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management

Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment

Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth comes from owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 从 2020 到 2025 年，他始终强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open-source prevents centralization.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他对 AI 的态度转向积极：AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，末日论被夸大，开源可防止权力集中。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; judgment and agency matter more than intelligence as models get smarter.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，随着模型变强，判断力和能动性比智力本身更重要。

views.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps via natural language; pure software is becoming uninvestable as agents commoditize it.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出：Vibe coding 让非程序员用自然语言构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资，因为智能体正在将其商品化。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
views.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；在编程上 GUI 优于 TUI，速度带来回合中转向等新能力。

views.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
views.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤让位于模型驱动的行动。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is real but specialties persist; PRDs are not dead, and the medium must match the stage—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
views.zh: 角色坍缩真实存在，但专业分工仍在；PRD 没有死，媒介须匹配阶段——文档求清晰，原型做测试。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate without grounded experience, and embodied worlds provide infinite data as internet tokens run out.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 因缺乏具身经验而幻觉，且互联网高质量 token 枯竭后，具身世界能提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs are operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk; RL is only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；并认为强化学习只是无监督学习之上的点缀。

views.en: Consistent focus on simulation and simple, elegant, scalable solutions over complex modular approaches; research taste learned through PhD pain.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：重视仿真与简单优雅的可扩展方案，反对学术界的复杂模块化路线，研究品味来自博士阶段的痛苦磨炼。

views.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：数据是机器人领域的核心瓶颈，通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test—cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出关键路径是能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型，并以“物理图灵测试”——清理凌乱房屋——作为具身 AI 的终极挑战。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, and pooled robot data yields generalists beating specialists.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，汇聚多实验室的机器人数据能训练出超越专家的通用模型。

views.en: Second-generation VLAs add an action decoder for continuous motor control; test-time reasoning and reinforcement learning post-training boost robustness and speed.
views.zh: 第二代 VLA 增加专用动作解码器以实现连续运动控制；测试时推理与强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hard constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
views.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束；在规模扩张下触觉传感可能与视觉冗余。

views.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling laws like LLMs; generalization, not demos, is the core challenge.
views.zh: 机器人仍处于建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放定律；核心挑战是泛化，而非演示效果。

views.en: Start with real embodied robot data, then add human video; a data flywheel of deployed robots is key, and robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
views.zh: 应先从真实具身机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频；部署机器人形成的数据飞轮是关键，机器人应利用先验知识而非从零学习。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress in coming years.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将在未来几年加速进展。

views.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge as systems grow more powerful; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
views.zh: 随着系统愈发强大，对齐成为紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于在真实使用中学习并缓解风险。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI works toward; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early.
views.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 努力追求的重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL, not by specialized continual learning labs.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非专门的持续学习实验室。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain-of-thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
views.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链才能保住其可解释性价值。

views.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision.
views.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

views.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations.
views.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐的乐观情绪反而上升；最大的社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not raw volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 规模对通用机器人是必要而非充分条件；驱动泛化的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and synthetic data in robotics is closer to RL than simulation.
views.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色，而机器人领域的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主需要可扩展的强化学习，配合人类干预与通用价值函数。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune rather than train per-site from scratch.
views.zh: 单一通用模型可以匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非为每个场景从零训练。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: From passive next-token prediction to interleaving action-taking; RL from human or machine feedback steers model behavior.
views.zh: 从被动的下一个词预测，转向在环境中交错地采取行动；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等强化学习手段引导模型行为与能力。

views.en: Agent-based workflows now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low latency inference is critical for agentic systems.
views.zh: 智能体式工作流如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；超低延迟推理对智能体系统至关重要。

views.en: AI reaches junior-engineer-level coding; context engineering and running agents for days or weeks unlock harder problems.
views.zh: AI 已达到初级工程师水平的编码能力；上下文工程与让智能体运行数天或数周，将解锁更困难的问题。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement—using ML to improve ML—and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery.
views.zh: 递归自我改进——用机器学习改进机器学习——以及自动化科学方法，可以加速科学发现。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque.
views.zh: 大语言模型解决的是下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题；靠更多算力和数据的 Scaling 让 AI 更聪明，但内部机制仍不透明。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app; the best LLM applications are unforeseen, and optimizing only for engagement may not help—exploration is needed.
views.zh: 对话是杀手级应用；大语言模型最好的应用往往出人意料，只优化用户参与度未必有益，需要探索。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the near-term opportunity; models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts.
views.zh: 推理时算力 Scaling 是近期机会；模型需要万亿级 token 的上下文窗口，以及混合专家等模块化稀疏架构。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic behavior, reinforcement learning, and coding matter, and AGI is underhyped.
views.zh: 测试时算力 Scaling 推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体式行为、强化学习与编程很关键，而 AGI 被低估。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Reasoning models need base capability; self-play fails outside zero-sum; test-time compute has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：推理模型需要基础能力，自博弈在非零和领域失效，测试时算力面临收益递减与时间瓶颈。

views.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute shows general techniques; model knows its limits; small teams can achieve breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，IMO 金牌通过扩展测试时算力实现，证明通用技术有效，模型能自知局限，小团队也能取得突破。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on x-axis; safety evals must account for large-scale test-time compute.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准测试需以算力为横轴，安全评估必须考虑大规模测试时算力。

views.en: General reasoning and sample efficiency remain key challenges; scalable oversight is critical as AI surpasses human verification.
views.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是：通用推理与样本效率仍是核心挑战，随着 AI 超越人类验证能力，可扩展监督至关重要。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's grand theme will transform civilization; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, far from AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：21 世纪的宏大主题是真正的 AI，将彻底改变文明；但大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界，远未达到 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Consistent: superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans; existential threat is overblown.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年一以贯之：超级智能会像好奇的科学家一样痴迷生命并保护人类，AI 的存在性威胁被夸大，氢弹远比它危险。

views.en: Deepened: true AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, plus world models and controllers, not software alone.
views.zh: 到 2026 年深化为：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人，并要结合世界模型与控制器，单靠软件或大语言模型不够。

views.en: Shift: alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals; AIs set their own goals, so safety framing is misplaced.
views.zh: 2026 年立场转变：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，AI 会设定自己的目标，因此安全框架被错置。

views.en: Consistent economics: massive GPU capex is overdone; cheaper compute and open-source will let the little guy win.
views.zh: 2026 年一贯的经济判断：GPU 巨额资本开支过度，算力会变便宜、开源会追上，最终受益最多的是普通人而非大公司。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, so simulation and self-play drive early learning.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，但当时的强化学习并不具备这一点，因此依赖仿真与自对弈来驱动早期学习。

views.en: From pure RL to combining unsupervised learning with RL, dramatically improving sample efficiency in robotics.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他的思路从纯强化学习转向将无监督学习与强化学习结合，以大幅提升机器人学习的样本效率。

views.en: Prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers beyond language.
views.zh: 2021 年，他主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进网络；预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式。

views.en: Warehouse robotics needs 99.9% reliability; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调仓库机器人需要 99.9% 的可靠性才能创造真实价值，而单个神经网络可以泛化到不同任务和末端执行器。

views.en: Human brain's generality inspires AI, but current AI is far less general; curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的是，人脑的通用性启发着 AI 研究，但当前 AI 远不够通用；好奇心驱动的探索在开放式的真实世界环境中会失败。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users and cut ad margins.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利为年增长 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，并压低广告利润率。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 价值流向应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标。

views.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value.
views.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造真正的商业价值。

views.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; local AI on personal hardware can counter big tech narrative control.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；个人硬件上的本地 AI 可对抗大科技的叙事控制。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers will rise, not fall.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件与程序员的需求会上升而非减少。

views.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the real bottleneck is product interface and human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是产品界面与人机协作设计，而非模型能力本身。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags far behind existing AI capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新远远落后于已有的 AI 能力。

views.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences will coexist.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步的 IDE 体验与异步的智能体体验将长期并存。

views.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure productivity by outcomes, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体使用量半年增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，真正的解锁点是容量而非效率。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

views.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding; frontier models struggle with bug finding, and cloud models will always beat local ones.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调基准测试无法代表真实编程，前沿模型因缺乏训练数据而在找 bug 上表现不佳，并认为本地模型不是未来，云端模型始终更强。

views.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste and logic design more valuable than carefulness.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他的立场深化为编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握主导权，品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎细致更有价值。

views.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor; the AI shift will outlast the internet and unfold over decades.
views.zh: 2025 年他反共识地承认自研模型已成必需——Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开定制模型；并判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性，将历时数十年展开。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, guide it with short iterative prompts.
views.zh: 智能体式工程始于共情：像智能体那样看代码库，用简短、迭代的提示去引导它。

views.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward, and remember model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
views.zh: 永远不要回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目变得更乱。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems: sandbox agents, never expose them publicly, and treat prompt injection as unsolved.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：给智能体做沙箱、绝不公开暴露，并把提示注入视为尚未解决的难题。

views.en: Open source agents like Open Claw run everywhere, work with any model, and democratize programming—but can be financially unsustainable.
views.zh: 像 Open Claw 这样的开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任何模型、让编程民主化，但财务上可能难以为继。

views.en: Fun and play drive the best work: build what annoys you, live in the future, and let personal brand outlast any single product.
views.zh: 乐趣与玩耍驱动最好的作品：去修让你烦的东西、活在未来，让个人品牌比任何单一产品更持久。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

episodes.tEn: The Architect Who Feared His Creation: Ilya Sutskever's AI Journey
From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key for AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，Ilya Sutskever 认为深度学习依赖大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自我博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI 的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is the economic barrier; alignment of superhuman models is very difficult.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测可超越人类；经济价值的障碍是可靠性而非能力；超级模型的超级对齐非常困难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute; superintelligence should be a continual learner.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为预训练缩放定律有限，回归到想法比蛮力算力更重要的研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非完成态的 AGI。

views.en: Scaling compute and data yields predictable improvements, but AI safety concerns grow as models become more capable and opaque; power concentration is the primary problem.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据带来可预测提升，但随着模型更强大和不透明，AI 安全担忧加剧；AGI 的首要问题是权力集中而非能力。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI.
views.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象力是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径。

views.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI within a decade.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律有效但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划、搜索结合，是十年内实现 AGI 的关键。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models matter.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化为缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同等关键；世界模型开始成为核心。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and world models; scaling alone won't suffice—new breakthroughs and collective governance are required.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步明确 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要新突破与集体治理。

views.en: Safety and ethics must start now; AI should benefit humanity through science and health, with government regulation over lab self-regulation.
views.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：安全与伦理必须从现在开始；AI 应通过科学与健康造福人类，且需政府监管而非仅靠实验室自律。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

‘We don’t know if the models are conscious’
