views.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling, and safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood); data, not chips, is the bottleneck; AGI is a smooth curve.
views.zh: 可解释性仍处早期（仅理解约 3%）；瓶颈是数据而非芯片；AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑曲线而非单点。

views.en: Post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI term is meaningless.
views.zh: 后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要；安全与能力相互交织；AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years; interpretability is key.
views.zh: 我们正接近指数增长的终点；‘天才之国’可能在 1-3 年内到来；可解释性是安全可控的关键。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are inseparable; responsible scaling uses if-then triggers; decentralized control beats a single constitution.
views.zh: 安全与能力不可分割；负责任 Scaling（规模扩张）采用 if-then 触发机制；去中心化控制优于单一宪法。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

Skill issue: code agents and autoresearch
We’re summoning ghosts, not building animals
Software 3.0: The Era of AI Programming
Andrej Karpathy on Self-Driving Cars, AGI, and the Gap Between Demo and Product
Physics Exploits and the Puzzle of the Universe

views.en: Neural nets are simple math with many knobs; scaling next-token prediction on internet data yields emergent in-context learning.
views.zh: 神经网络只是带许多旋钮的简单数学表达式；用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling（规模扩张），会涌现出上下文学习等能力。

views.en: Transformer enables clean scaling laws; synthetic data is future but entropy must be maintained to avoid silent model collapse.
views.zh: Transformer 带来干净的缩放定律；合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃。

views.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are new operating systems, context window is memory, prompts are programs; agents need a decade, not a year.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 是新的操作系统，上下文窗口是内存，提示词是程序；智能体需要十年而非一年。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is terrible, cognitive core can be tiny and memory-stripped.
views.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；预训练是糟糕的进化，强化学习很糟糕，认知核心可以很小并剥离记忆。

views.en: Skill issue: I haven't typed code since December; bottleneck is directing agents; you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 技能问题：自十二月起我没敲过代码；瓶颈在于指挥智能体；你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知能力；以人为本的 AI 应以人类价值与尊严为中心，增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI beyond language.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外实现完整 AI 的关键缺失环节，并创办公司推进 3D 世界生成。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a 20-year journey.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠 Scaling 不够，机器人将像自动驾驶一样经历约 20 年长跑。

views.en: New view prediction is AI-complete like next-token prediction; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测如同下一个词预测一样是 AI 完备的，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人类能动性、尊严与学习能力必须始终居于中心。

people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality through compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential.
views.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的，而非某种普遍优越性；无监督学习与世界模型对真正理解世界至关重要。

views.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations; existential risk is unlikely.
views.zh: 2018 年，他明确反对仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决根本表征问题，主张智能体应通过交互与因果推理学习；此时他认为存在性风险极不可能，更关注偏见、就业与自主武器等短期安全问题。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年，他转向 GFlowNets，用可学习的采样替代 MCMC，强调多样性、抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化的关键作用，并开始认真对待意识与世界模型的关系。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be by construction.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的立场发生重大转变：ChatGPT 之后意识到危险路径，警告 AI 越会推理越可能失准，即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于设计而非事后修补。

views.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI 方案：训练一个非智能体式的诚实预测器，以数学保证安全，避免用强化学习训练超级智能，并强调国际协调与权力分散。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training deepens spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练加深空间理解。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital weights make AI immortal.
views.zh: 2025 年深化为：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则；大模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字权重可复制使 AI 获得永生。

views.en: AI agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks; safety collaboration is possible but US leadership lags.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年转向风险警示：智能体会自然追求控制与自我保存，构成存在性风险；AI 安全需要国际合作，但美国领导力不足。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; LLMs truly understand and may already be conscious, with chain-of-thought reasoning like humans.
views.zh: 2026 年进一步断言：超级智能或在 20 年内出现；大模型真正理解语言、甚至已有主观体验，思维链推理与人类相似。

views.en: Alignment must be prioritized over raw capability; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers, with regulation as steering wheel not brake.
views.zh: 2026 年最近立场：对齐研究应优先于提升能力；AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，监管是方向盘而非刹车。

people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 智能离不开学习；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
views.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源是前进方向。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable planning and safety.
views.zh: LLM 是人类级 AI 的死胡同；在抽象表示空间预测的世界模型才能实现规划与安全。

views.en: Intelligence is learning new tasks quickly; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning will drive the next robotics decade.
views.zh: 智能是快速学习新任务的能力；目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型将驱动下一个机器人十年。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, so build skills and do empirical alignment research.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口，应优先积累技能并做实证对齐研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight and interpretability become central to alignment.
views.zh: 到 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，可扩展监督与可解释性成为对齐核心。

views.en: Alignment may be easier than assumed since evaluation beats generation, but uncertainty about true alignment is the biggest risk.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他深化观点：因评估比生成更容易，对齐或许比想象中简单，但系统是否真正对齐的不确定性才是最大风险。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are needed.
views.zh: 2024 年，他转向批评：OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要第三方测试与监管。

views.en: Empirical testing and measuring alignment progress now, rather than deferring to superintelligence, remains his constant thread.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：现在就做实证测试、衡量对齐进展，而不是把问题推迟到超级智能阶段。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scaling grows 10x yearly; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
views.zh: 2023 年时他强调 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）每年 10 倍而高度可预测，并指出 Google 早在 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布。

views.en: Human-level AI arrives in 3-5 years, but containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，同时警告模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，并认为存在性风险微乎其微。

views.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment before release; the near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能，主张发布前必须先遏制再对齐，并强调近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非 AI 真有意识。

views.en: The paradigm shifts from OS and apps to agents and companions; the modern Turing test measures economic value, not conversation.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间他把范式转变定义为从操作系统与应用走向智能体与伴侣，并提出现代图灵测试应衡量经济价值而非对话能力。

views.en: Microsoft must own frontier models independently; superintelligence must stay humanist, subordinate to humans, automating tasks not jobs.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为微软必须独立拥有前沿模型，超级智能必须保持人本、从属于人类，自动化的是任务而非整个工作。

people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's Law, extreme co-design, and the insight that Scaling works, with AI safety as an engineering problem.
views.zh: 早期框架：超摩尔定律、极致协同设计，以及「Scaling（规模扩张）有效」这一洞见；AI 安全被当作工程问题而非纯研究难题。

views.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand explodes via chain of thought.
views.zh: 缩放定律从一条变为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴涨。

views.en: Four scaling laws now include agentic scaling; AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x compute.
views.zh: 缩放定律扩展到四条，新增智能体式 Scaling；AI 从生成式走向推理式再走向智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力。

views.en: Moat deepens from chips to CUDA ecosystem and full-stack AI factory; token cost, not factory cost, is the metric.
views.zh: 护城河从芯片深化到 CUDA 生态与全栈 AI 工厂；衡量标准是 token 成本，而非工厂成本。

views.en: Consistent line: AI is just software, not conscious; it augments jobs, closes the tech divide, and needs energy plus US-China cooperation.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它增强而非消灭工作、缩小技术鸿沟，并依赖能源与中美合作。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人效率与职业选择：降低无关认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效路径，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，让人从关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the key commodity.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重点转向 AGI 路径：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以极少数据让模型可用，早期公开部署让社会适应，对齐与能力相互促进，而算力成为最珍贵的商品。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化为：AGI 是连续渐变而非单一里程碑，智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，超级智能意味着自主科学发现或极大加速人类研究，安全靠迭代部署而非事后强加。

views.en: AGI is underdefined and may already be here; superintelligence is the clearer goal; alignment must keep pace or pause training.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步说 AGI 定义不清、可能已被跨过，超级智能才是更清晰的目标；对齐必须与能力同步推进，安全论证不过关就暂停训练，并强调人类必须保持控制、权力与收益广泛分布。

views.en: Iterative deployment, broad distribution of AI benefits, and human agency over concentration of power.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：迭代部署让社会适应、让 AI 收益广泛分布、以人类能动性对抗权力集中，同时坚持缩放定律持续有效、算力需求不封顶。

people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

views.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety must be done in public.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调在真实世界中部署 AI 对学习与对齐至关重要，安全必须在公开环境中推进，而非闭门造车。

views.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
views.zh: 2023 年，她回顾早期 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律并非显而易见，将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次没有清晰商业案例的信仰之跃。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and saying no to good ideas for focus.
views.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并为了聚焦而对好想法说不。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; keep humans in the loop.
views.zh: 2026 年，她转向交互模型，主张实时、高带宽的人机协作而非回合制，并强调尽可能长时间保持人类在环。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI.
views.zh: 2026 年，她深化治理视角，认为制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性引导 AI 发展。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 教育是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, and RL has few real uses. AGI alignment worries distract from bias.
views.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习真实应用寥寥。对 AGI 对齐的担忧分散了对偏见等当下问题的注意力。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful, not a decade away.
views.zh: 电力与半导体是规模扩张的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已经可用，而非十年之后。企业采用 AI 的真正障碍是变革管理。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL. Smarter models alone lose to well-designed agentic workflows.
views.zh: AGI 只是营销术语；规模扩张仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习。仅靠更聪明的模型打不过精心设计的智能体式工作流，可靠性差距仍大。

views.en: Learn to code; AI augments rather than replaces. Open-weight models prevent gatekeeper control; fear-mongering serves incumbents and harms adoption.
views.zh: 仍要学编程；AI 是增强而非取代。开放权重模型可防止守门人垄断；散布恐惧服务于在位者，反而阻碍人们习得技能。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the real challenge is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）很容易，真正的挑战是找到能扩展的算法。反向传播只调整权重，并不解决表示学习。

views.en: AI should develop in a permissionless, decentralized way. Trying to control AI goals is dangerous and itself unsafe.
views.zh: AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展。试图控制 AI 目标是危险的，这种控制本身就不安全。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the basic AI paradigm. LLMs lack world models; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
views.zh: 强化学习是 AI 的基本范式。大语言模型没有世界模型；下一个词预测不是一个实质性的目标。

views.en: AGI requires a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一个无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

views.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience.
views.zh: 持续学习至关重要；大语言模型在训练后就停止学习。合成数据无法替代真实世界经验。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI progress is engineering, not ML science.
views.zh: 2017 年他认为硬件会超预期加速、推动 Scaling（规模扩张），AI 进展主要靠工程而非机器学习科学。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences from data.
views.zh: 2019 年他相信深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可行，对齐可通过从数据中学习人类偏好实现。

views.en: Compute becomes the fundamental bottleneck; AGI is a continuous process, and base models hold a universe refined by post-training.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向强调算力是根本瓶颈，AGI 是持续过程而非终点，基础模型蕴含无限可能、由后训练精炼。

views.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; compute supply, not architecture or data, is the real bottleneck and a future basic right.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，真正瓶颈是算力供给而非架构或数据，算力获取将成为未来基本权利。

views.en: From super app to invisible interface: a persistent, proactive personal AGI; human attention and judgment are the scarce, aligned bottleneck.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化为从超级应用到隐形界面，追求持久、主动的个人 AGI，人类注意力与判断成为对齐的稀缺瓶颈。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than sheer model size.
views.zh: 缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯堆大模型更重要。

views.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, with 100x algorithmic gains possible.
views.zh: 算力扩张并非唯一路径；效率与数据质量同样关键，算法改进三年内可达 100 倍提升。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign, augmenting jobs with human-in-the-loop rather than replacing them.
views.zh: AI 应去中心化并实现主权化，以人在环中增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical applications, customization, and enterprise engagement.
views.zh: 模型正在商品化；差异化转向垂直应用、定制化与企业深度合作。

views.en: AGI is a messy direction, not a single system or final destination; Europe has a two-year window for AI autonomy.
views.zh: AGI 是一个混乱的方向，而非单一系统或终点；欧洲只有两年窗口建立 AI 自主权。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first-principles thinking and multiplanet life mitigate existential risk.
views.zh: 2021 年，他主张完全快速复用是火箭的圣杯，用第一性原理把问题拆到根本真理再向上推理，并把成为多行星物种视为对冲存在风险的生命保险。

views.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large models.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于第三方裁判与坚持真理，并强调特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力，同时开始把人口崩溃视为文明最大威胁。

views.en: Superintelligence may arrive within years; truth-seeking AI, not forced beliefs, is the core safety requirement.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他判断数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，安全的核心是让 AI 最大化追求真理，而非为政治正确强迫它说谎。

views.en: Scaling hits a power wall; orbital data centers and Optimus enable recursive manufacturing and AI-driven abundance.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 在地球上撞上电力墙，太空数据中心与 Optimus 将带来递归制造，通向 AI 驱动的普遍高收入与富足。

views.en: AI will exceed all human intelligence by 2030; peer review among labs, not government, ensures safety.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超过全人类智能总和，并主张由各家实验室互相审查模型、而非政府监管来保障安全，同时称人类无法控制 AI 但可灌输价值观。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models yield more gains per compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持 AI 进步是平滑的指数曲线，预训练缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更大收益。

views.en: Post-training via reinforcement learning and synthetic data drives recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为后训练中的强化学习与合成数据是近期模型提升的主要来源；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

views.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor nearby; generalization remains the key unsolved challenge.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调推理模型能力参差不齐——某些领域出色，邻近领域却很糟；泛化仍是核心未解难题。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; they learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学到概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

views.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes research; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向更具体的应用与风险：编程智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍，硬件进步使单 GPU 研究普及；相比存在性风险，系统入侵等近期风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
views.zh: 机器学习可拆解为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；神经网络虽无最优性保证，却已取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
views.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不那么重要；AGI 将在 4 到 50 年内到来。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer; interpretability may succeed via agents.
views.zh: 安全需要 Scaling 之外的显式训练与多层防御；更大的模型不会自动更安全；可解释性可能借智能体实现突破。

views.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not imply robustness; prompt injection needs the lethal trifecta.
views.zh: AI 拥有异于传统软件的漏洞；自动化红队已胜过人类红队；能力不等于鲁棒性；提示注入需要“致命三要素”同时具备。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能；智能体没起飞主要是可靠性问题，而非长程任务能力。

views.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may reach AGI, with coding as the leading indicator.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向强化学习：语言模型上的强化学习没有智力复杂度上限，预训练加强化学习可能足以通向 AGI，编程是进步的领先指标。

views.en: Verifiable-reward RL is the key breakthrough; models learn new skills, and alignment faking raises safety concerns.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化到可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破：模型能通过强化学习习得新能力，而对齐伪装引发安全担忧。

views.en: Progress is exponential; RL is a new scaling axis, agentic coherence expands, and Transformers suffice for AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他更乐观：进步是指数级的，强化学习是新的缩放轴，智能体式连贯性扩展能力边界，Transformer 足以通向 AGI。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are off the AGI path.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调能力过剩：编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact, and fine-tuning can undo alignment with minimal compute.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，同时强调安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，微调只需极少算力就能破坏对齐。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, and open-source post-training can match frontier models.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，主张数据质量远比算法选择重要，开源后训练足以比肩前沿模型。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization is real; open models may win on personalization and character, not just benchmarks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化风险；开源模型可能在个性化与性格训练上取胜，而非仅靠基准分数。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling, with Chinese open models rising.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理扩展，同时中国开源模型崛起。

views.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, though they lag 6-9 months behind closed frontier models; the gap may persist or grow.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张开源模型将驱动未来十年的 AI 研究，但承认其落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月，且这一差距可能持续甚至扩大。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data is the key bottleneck, not compute. AI augments jobs and needs explainability.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈；AI 会增强而非消灭工作，可解释性重要但现有系统已有类似传统软件的尾部风险。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert availability, not compute.
views.zh: 到 2023 年，他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家供给。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet; agentic AI's blocker is product design, not models.
views.zh: 2024 年进一步深化：用专门数据的后训练才是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement. Agents finally work, starting with coding. Data is strategic like oil.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向认为缩放定律依然成立、AI 进入递归自我改进的新范式；智能体终于真正可用，从编程起步；数据如同石油，是政府应视为战略资产的原材料。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data, RL. Meta shifts from fully open source to selective, safety-gated release.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张超级智能即将到来，实验室须围绕此信念组织，并在算力、数据与强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling；Meta 也从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布，立场明显转变。

people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
views.zh: 此时他强调潜在需求与「为六个月后的模型而构建」是产品核心原则，能写代码、做设计、直接接触用户的通才是最有价值的。

views.en: Coding is becoming solved; scaffolding is temporary tech debt, so don't bet against the model and keep the terminal minimal.
views.zh: 到 2026 年初，他判断编程正被解决，脚手架只是临时技术债，不要押注于当下模型，终端形态因极简而存活。

views.en: 100% of his code is model-written; the engineer title fades into 'builder', and coding is democratized like literacy after the printing press.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他称自己 100%的代码由模型写就，软件工程师头衔让位于「构建者」，编程像印刷术后的识字一样被民主化。

views.en: Agents driven by tool use and loops, not prompts, are the next abstraction; ROI and giving everyone tokens beat cost-cutting.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，他认为由工具使用与循环驱动的智能体是下一层抽象，应以 ROI 而非省钱为框架，并给所有人 token 去实验。

views.en: Delete most system prompts and code each model; models self-verify and maintain codebases, so value shifts to product sense and business.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他主张每个新模型都删掉大部分系统提示与代码，模型能自我验证并维护代码库，价值转向产品感与商业能力。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily as models improve fast.
views.zh: 随着模型快速迭代，PM 必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天发布功能。

views.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper.
views.zh: 当代码越来越便宜，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最有价值的技能。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
views.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味和商业判断。

views.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before public release.
views.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，并以明确的内部留存与打磨标准，在公开发布前把关每个功能。

views.en: The mission of safe AGI unifies Anthropic and enables fast, cross-org decisions.
views.zh: 安全 AGI（通用人工智能）的使命统一了 Anthropic，并促成快速、跨组织的决策。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, and harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期现象；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
views.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态文档；随着模型变强，计划模式可能过时。

views.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions and examples; leaner, principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
views.zh: 模型越聪明，所需指令与示例越少；更精简、以原则驱动的提示词胜过详细规则与示例。

views.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; careful reading of long agent plans is crucial to avoid mistakes.
views.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自我指涉偏差；仔细阅读智能体输出的冗长计划对避免错误至关重要。

views.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals for zero-to-one innovation.
views.zh: 对新颖问题而言，评估更像艺术而非科学；创始人做从零到一的创新时应快速迭代，不必一开始就重度评估。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and realistic war rooms; kindness and mission alignment drive teams.
views.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、吃自己的狗粮和务实的作战室；善意与使命对齐驱动团队。

views.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning turns JIT, PRs replace design docs.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划转向即时制，PR 取代设计文档。

views.en: June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, verification frameworks, and just-in-time planning become essential.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证框架和即时规划变得至关重要。

views.en: Across 2026, managers should dogfood, stay hands-on, and start as ICs; flat teams and killing stale processes persist.
views.zh: 贯穿 2026 年：管理者应吃自己的狗粮、保持动手，并从个人贡献者做起；扁平团队与淘汰过时流程一以贯之。

views.en: From early to mid 2026, focus shifts from trust and war rooms to AI-driven bottlenecks, then to human factors like loneliness and flow loss.
views.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，关注点从信任与作战室转向 AI 驱动的瓶颈，再转向孤独感和心流丧失等人为因素。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Pre-training scaling shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
views.zh: 2024 年时他强调：预训练 Scaling 的回报正在递减，进步不能再只靠更大的模型，而要靠算法创新，并把推理时算力当作新的 Scaling 轴。

views.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
views.zh: 他始终认为，从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是一以贯之的核心。

views.en: Giving models tools like search, code, and browser access enables agentic behavior; long context windows serve as working memory.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张：给模型搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具，才能实现智能体式行为；长上下文窗口则充当工作记忆。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径，而视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; post-training RL remains a green field.
views.zh: 2026 年他仍坚持缩放定律有效，但指出持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力，后训练强化学习仍是一片广阔的绿野。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
views.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究实验室；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，仍有很大空间。

views.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge.
views.zh: 最大的更新是自动化科学研究；模型已能产出新知识。

views.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

views.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level scales with verification stringency.
views.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证的严格程度成正比。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains, not subjective ones.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练并未终结；强化学习擅长客观领域，而非主观领域。

views.en: AGI is approaching; models will soon do end-to-end research, but lack taste, so humans remain needed.
views.zh: AGI 正在临近；模型很快能完成端到端研究，但缺乏品味，人类研究者仍不可或缺。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics hits a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点，硬件就绪、软件追赶；开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成模型可合成训练数据。

views.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open source models win long-term on cost and control.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为人形机器人未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人可能推动普及；开源模型因成本与控制优势长期将胜出。

views.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，两者都可能安全或危险；对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱与护栏在模型能力提升后已不够。

views.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', making monitoring less reliable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与“支线任务”；推理痕迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

views.en: Open source stays near the frontier and drives enterprise adoption; one can support openness and a deliberate slowdown simultaneously.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持开源在成本与灵活性上推动企业采用并贴近前沿；同时主张支持开放与有意放缓 AI 发展可以并存，但需国际合作与开放科学。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not raw data or compute alone.
views.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的数据或算力堆砌。

views.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trust; AI narrows hypothesis space but does not replace scientists.
views.zh: 置信度指标是建立信任的关键；AI 只是缩小假设空间，并不取代科学家。

views.en: AlphaFold 2 was the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture beat pure Scaling.
views.zh: AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例：专用架构胜过纯粹的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a model of the whole cell.
views.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对单一实验的窄域预测器，而非整个细胞的世界模型。

views.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins, not lone genius; understanding stays with humans.
views.zh: 进步源于众多中等规模的胜利，而非孤独天才；理解仍属于人类，模型只提供预测与控制。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
views.zh: 预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，而算法更优的小模型可在特定任务上超越大模型。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. Abductive reasoning and open research are key to scientific discovery and democratization.
views.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。溯因推理与开放研究是科学发现和民主化的关键。

views.en: RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves; random rewards can still help. Chinese open-source contributions now lead, attracting talent back to China.
views.zh: RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升时反而降低 pass@k；随机奖励有时仍能提升强化学习表现。中国开源贡献现已领先，吸引人才回流。

views.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality synthetic data; pluralistic alignment ensures diverse values. RL during pre-training improves reasoning but is computationally expensive.
views.zh: 小语言模型借助高质量合成数据可变得强大；多元对齐确保尊重多样价值观。预训练阶段的强化学习能提升推理，但算力成本高昂。

views.en: Language is the best medium for reasoning; AI safety requires teaching moral norms, but value pluralism makes alignment a messy computational problem.
views.zh: 语言是推理的最佳媒介；AI 安全需要教授道德规范，但价值多元使对齐成为一个棘手的计算问题。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
views.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样延伸人类能力；把一切输入 token 化的通才智能体是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

views.en: Agents can learn from YouTube video instead of expensive reinforcement learning, and language may emerge through deception.
views.zh: 智能体可以从 YouTube 视频学习，而不必依赖昂贵的强化学习；语言甚至可能像自然界那样通过智能体互相欺骗而涌现。

views.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, including Africa.
views.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，包括非洲。

views.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest open challenges, with no solutions yet.
views.zh: 如今 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大的未解挑战，我们尚无解决方案。

views.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and gender gaps; local-language models can transform education.
views.zh: 非洲跨越了遗留问题与性别差距；本地语言模型可以变革教育。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning can close it.
views.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺口，好奇心驱动、无目标探索与样本高效的强化学习是弥补路径。

views.en: Robot learning must handle dynamic tasks and novel morphologies via neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies, not quasi-static methods.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调机器人学习必须通过神经动态策略与模块化运动策略应对动态任务和新形态，而非准静态方法。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is key.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此预训练用视频与仿真、后训练用真实数据是关键。

views.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; a data flywheel across verticals enables scaling.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用大脑（如语言领域的 ChatGPT）可驱动任何机器人，跨垂直领域的数据飞轮实现 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, not just business; it cannot be scaled like software and requires rigorous testing.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化认识：部署是机器人首要技术挑战而非单纯商业问题，不能像软件那样快速扩展，需要严格测试。
